name: Kyousou no Nie Ni
source:
A small village in the mountains. Since ancient times some unique rituals have been practiced there. One of them is an event held each 10 years. It includes training girls of the village by the most powerful family. Main character is in charge of the ritual this time. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
深山里有一座小村庄，自古流传着若干独特仪式。其中一项每十年举行一次，由村中最有权势的家族负责调教村里的女孩。这一次，主角将主持仪式。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
